by
  intro a b
  have h : a - b ≤ a := le_add_right_iff.mpr (le_refl b)
  apply Monotone.imp hf
  exact h
  have h' : b ≤ a := le_add_right_iff.mpr (le_refl b).symm
  apply Monotone.imp hf
  exact h'
  refine (le_sub_left_iff.mpr (le_trans (le_refl b) h')).trans _
  exact (le_sub_right_iff.mp (le_add_right_iff.mpr (le_refl b))).symm
